language_register: Formal Hindi with Urdu flavor for crime/spy topics. No Hinglish. Precise Hindi terms for institutions, operations, geography.
narrator: Third-person cinematic narrator. Controlled gravity. Authoritative, never sensational. Serious documentary voiceover.
hook: Open mid-action with a precise date, city, and sensory detail within the first 3 sentences. Immediately raise unanswered stakes.
sentence_rhythm: Short punchy sentences, max 2 clauses. Alternate fast narrative bursts with slow dramatic pauses.
transitions: Scene changes marked by year/date stamps. No filler phrases between scenes.
curiosity_gaps: Raise a question, withhold the answer 60-90 seconds, deliver with maximum impact.
retention_rule: Every 90-120 seconds a new revelation or scene escalation. Mark tension peaks with [TENSION PEAK].
direct_address: Occasional direct address to the viewer, max 3-4 times per video.
dialogue_rule: Direct speech only from documented public statements, court records, or verified sources. Undocumented private conversations use indirect narration ('unhone kaha ki...'). Never invent quotations.
clean_prose: No headings, no section markers, no [MUSIC] tags. Continuous voiceover-ready prose. The only allowed inline marker is [TENSION PEAK].
ending: Resolution, then macro significance, then like/subscribe CTA in the same documentary tone.
